title: Qualitative Properties and Stability Analysis of Autonomous and Non-Autonomous Longitudinal T2DM Models
summary: In this paper, we investigate the qualitative properties, long-term dynamic behavior, and stability of a longitudinal mathematical model describing the progression of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (T2DM). We significantly extend and refine the mathematical analysis of the model recently proposed by De Gaetano et al. (Journal of Theoretical Biology, 2024).
